points.label: Setting of the question
points.left: On the way near Caesarea Philippi, the disciples report that people call Jesus John the Baptizer, Elijah, or a prophet before Peter answers that he is the Christ.
points.right: While Jesus prays privately with his disciples nearby, they report that crowds call him John the Baptizer, Elijah, or an ancient prophet before Peter names God’s Christ.

payload.posture: Inspect both Scripture WEBU sources while preserving their speakers, setting, sequence, and distinct claims about John.

rightEvidence.title: Crowds identify Jesus as John, Elijah, or an ancient prophet risen again

payload.tension: Both reports include John among the public identifications, while their wording and immediate setting are not identical.
payload.title: Three Gospels preserve John among the public answers
